about: The first real testnet exit attempt (4 Oct 2026). The certificate (testnet-exit-first-attempt.pof) named the wallet's two notes; deposit 1 spent both, but the wallet split change into 4 outputs, so the Ironwood bundle carried 3 dummy spends whose nullifiers cannot be told from real spends: the strict rule answers Mismatch. Deposit 2 spent change notes the certificate never named: Mismatch, correctly. Lesson: exit transactions must carry no dummy spends (spend >= 2 certified notes into no more outputs than spends), or use the certificate's padding notes as the dummies.
